remove_account_message: {email} leaves this app and its stored sign-in is deleted. You can add it again later.
reset_message: This clears the locally cached mail and re-downloads everything from the server. It's destructive but ensures a clean state, useful after an update changes how mail is parsed. Queued sends are kept.
delete_permanently_message: This message will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
compose_discard_message: This message hasn't been sent. If you discard it, what you've written is lost.
unfiled_copy_body: “{subject}” reached its recipients, but a copy couldn't be saved in your Sent folder.
quote_style_indented_description: The original is indented below one line saying who wrote it, and when.
quote_style_line_header_description: The original sits below a dividing line, under a labelled From / Sent / To / Subject block.
quote_preview_body: Are we still on for lunch?
settings_quote_per_message_description: Show the quote style in every reply and forward, so you can pick a different one for a single message. Your default above stays as it is.
event_series_note: Changes apply to the whole series.
event_series_warning_title: Save changes to the whole series?
event_series_warning_reset: Events you moved to another time will go back to the series' time.
event_series_warning_renames: Events you renamed will take the series' name.
event_series_warning_reset_and_renames: Events you moved to another time will go back to the series' time, and events you renamed will take the series' name.
event_editor_invalid: Enter a title and an end after the start.
event_repeat_sum_monthly_last_n: Every {count} months on the last day
event_repeat_series_note: Changing the repeat changes the whole series.
event_repeat_locked: This repeat is too detailed to change here.
reading_no_content: This message has no displayable content.
reading_remote_blocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
reading_webview_unavailable: Couldn't display this message (the web content renderer is unavailable).
calendar_reauth_prompt: Calendar access needs your permission for {accounts}.
mail_reauth_prompt: Sending and managing mail needs your permission for {accounts}.
signin_expired_prompt: The sign-in for {accounts} no longer works. Sign in again to keep syncing.
signin_expired_prompt_settings: The sign-in for {accounts} no longer works. Update it in Settings to keep syncing.
signin_expired_failed: Signing in again didn’t work. Please try again.
tz_changed_message: Your device is now in {zone}. Update the display time zone?
accounts_skipped_notice: Some accounts couldn't connect and were skipped: {details}
setup_microsoft_note: Sign in with your Microsoft account in your browser: nothing is stored here but a secure token. Reads your mail and calendar; sending comes later.
setup_microsoft_browser_failed: Could not open Microsoft sign-in. Please try again.
setup_microsoft_timeout: Microsoft sign-in timed out. Please try again.
setup_google_note: Sign in with your Google account in your browser: nothing is stored here but a secure token. Connects Gmail and Google Calendar directly.
setup_google_browser_failed: Could not open Google sign-in. Please try again.
setup_google_timeout: Google sign-in timed out. Please try again.
setup_google_early_access_body: Google sign-in is in Early Access while Google reviews the app. To use it, you must first sign up with the email address you're adding. Otherwise Google will block the sign-in.
setup_google_early_access_confirm: I've signed up for Early Access with this address
setup_jmap_note: Connect a JMAP account, such as Fastmail or a self-hosted server.
setup_jmap_signin_checking: Checking how you can sign in…
setup_jmap_signin_note: Your provider supports signing in directly, so there's no API token to create.
setup_jmap_signin_failed: Signing in didn't work. You can connect with a password or API token instead.
setup_jmap_secret_note: Enter whichever your server issued: a password or an API token. Either works. Leave the server blank to discover it from your email domain.
setup_description: Enter your mail server, email, and password. Just the server name: we use the standard secure port automatically. SMTP and calendar are optional.
setup_credentials_note: Your credentials are stored in your device's secure storage, not on disk.
setup_port_note: Just the server name: we use the standard secure port automatically.
setup_allodia_subtitle: Keeps your list of mail accounts the same on your phone and your computer. Your mail and your passwords stay on your devices.
setup_allodia_divider: Or connect a mail account directly
setup_allodia_none_body: You’re signed in to your Allodia account. Add your first mail account below: its address and settings will then be offered on your other devices.
setup_detect_description: Enter your email address and we'll look up your provider's settings.
setup_detect_found_jmap_note: Your provider supports JMAP. Just add your password or an API token.
setup_detect_untrusted_warning: We received these settings over a connection that isn't fully secure. Please double-check the server names before continuing.
setup_detect_reason_nothing: We couldn't find settings for that address. You can enter them yourself.
setup_detect_reason_network: We couldn't reach the network to look up your settings. Check your connection and try again, or enter them yourself.
setup_detect_reason_oauth_only: Your provider needs a sign-in method we don't support yet. You can enter your settings manually.
setup_detect_microsoft_hint: This looks like a Microsoft account. Sign in with Microsoft to continue.
setup_detect_google_hint: This looks like a Google account. Sign in with Google to continue.
setup_detect_app_password_hint: Some providers require an app-specific password instead of your normal one.
setup_detect_calendar_add: This account also has a calendar
settings_language_description: Choose the language you want to use. Changes apply after a restart.
settings_language_restart_message: Your language preference is saved. Restart the app to apply it.
settings_sync_depth_description: How far back to download mail. Older messages stay on the server and download when you open a folder.
settings_message_size_description: The largest message to download in the background. Larger ones stay on the server and download when you open them.
settings_sync_description: Choose how each account checks for new messages.
settings_sync_strategy_push: Receive emails as they come in
settings_sync_strategy_push_detail: New messages arrive over a live connection, so they show up right away.
settings_sync_strategy_poll_detail: We check for new messages at a set interval.
settings_sync_folders_note: Watch up to {count} folders for incoming mail.
settings_sync_idle_unsupported: This server doesn't support live delivery, so we check on a schedule instead.
settings_appearance_description: Light or dark. Follows your system unless you pick one.
settings_time_format_description: How times are shown, in mail and calendar alike.
settings_week_start_description: Which day the calendar week begins on.
settings_horizon_description: How much of the day the calendar shows at once. Pinch the grid to zoom in or out; what you settle on is remembered.
settings_default_calendar_description: Where a new event goes unless you pick another calendar. It is also the colour a new event is drawn in on the grid.
settings_default_calendar_none: No calendar can take new events yet.
settings_timezone_description: The time zone your agenda and message times are shown in.
settings_grouping_description: Group your message list into conversations, or show individual messages.
settings_composing_description: How replies and forwards quote the original message.
settings_send_account_description: Which account new messages are sent from when you're looking at the combined inbox. Replies always start from the account that received the mail.
settings_swipe_description: What swiping a message left or right does. After a swipe you can undo it straight away.
settings_accounts_empty: Add an account to manage its mail settings.
settings_allodia_description: Sign in for the services Allodia runs. It holds no mailbox and cannot read your mail. Your mail accounts are separate.
settings_allodia_timeout: Sign-in timed out. Please try again.
settings_allodia_browser_failed: Couldn’t open sign-in. Please try again.
settings_category_allodia_summary: Sign in to Allodia and manage your account
settings_allodia_manage_hint: Opens your account page, where you can change your details or delete your account.
settings_account_sync_on_hint: This account is on your other devices, and changes to its settings travel between them. Your mail and your password never leave this device.
settings_account_sync_paused_hint: Your other devices keep this account, but changes stop travelling in either direction. Use it when the settings here need to differ from theirs.
settings_account_sync_off_hint: This account is only on this device. It is taken off your other devices, and Allodia keeps no record of it.
settings_allodia_sync_description: Accounts you added on another device. Setting one up here asks for its password. Passwords never leave the device they were typed on.
settings_allodia_reauth: Sign in again to keep your accounts in step
settings_allodia_reauth_hint: This device’s sign-in was made before this feature existed, so it cannot see your account list yet. Signing in again is all it takes; nothing else changes.
settings_allodia_signed_out_elsewhere: You’re signed out of your Allodia account
settings_allodia_signed_out_elsewhere_hi: Your account was signed out or removed somewhere else. Your mail accounts and your mail are untouched.
settings_allodia_sync_unavailable: Couldn’t check your other devices. It will try again later.
settings_advanced_reset_description: Clear the locally cached mail and download everything again from the server. Queued sends are kept.
settings_mcp_description: Let an AI assistant on this computer read and act on your mail, through the Model Context Protocol. It is off unless you turn it on, it reaches only the accounts you tick, and nothing is sent to Allodia.
settings_mcp_toggle: Allow assistants to use my mail
settings_mcp_status_running: Running · waiting for a client to connect
settings_mcp_status_unavailable: On, but not listening: see the diagnostic log
settings_mcp_accounts_description: None to begin with. Tick an account to let an assistant read and act on its mail.
settings_mcp_accounts_empty: No accounts are shared yet, so an assistant sees an empty mailbox.
settings_mcp_send_note: Off means an assistant opens a draft for you to review and send.
settings_mcp_known_recipient_toggle: Only send to people you already email
settings_mcp_known_recipient_note: Stops an assistant sending your mail to an address you have never written to.
settings_mcp_config_description: Paste this into your assistant's MCP configuration, then restart it.
diagnostics_log_description: A local record of what the app did, kept on this device to help diagnose problems. It holds counts, ids, durations, and events; never message content, addresses, or credentials.
diagnostics_share_privacy_note: This file records app activity as counts, ids, durations, and events. It never contains message content, addresses, or credentials.
diagnostics_log_cap_note: Capped at about 4 MB; the oldest entries are dropped first.
diagnostics_debug_description: Log extra detail (DEBUG) during a support session. The log fills up faster, so turn this off when you're done.
settings_analytics_description: Optional, and off unless you turn it on. You can turn it off again at any time; we then delete what we hold.
settings_signatures_library_description: Write a signature once and use it on any account.
settings_signatures_defaults_description: Which signature each account starts a message with. You can still pick a different one, or none, in the composer.
settings_signatures_empty: You haven't written a signature yet.
settings_signatures_delete_message: It is removed from every account that uses it. This can't be undone.
settings_signatures_image_too_large: That image is too large. Pick one under {limit}.
settings_category_general_summary: Language, appearance, time zone, and time format
settings_category_calendar_summary: First day of the week, default zoom, and default calendar
settings_category_composing_summary: Quote style and which account sends new mail
settings_category_signatures_summary: Write signatures and pick one per account
settings_category_accounts_summary: How far back and how often each account fetches mail
settings_category_diagnostics_summary: View, share, or export the diagnostic log
settings_category_about_summary: Version, support, and what the app is built on
about_support_description: Questions, problems, or an idea for the app: ask on our support forum.
about_attributions_description: {app_name} is built on the work of others, used under these licences.
settings_notifications_description: Notify me when new mail arrives while the app is in the background.
settings_battery_description: Android is currently allowed to postpone this app's background checks to save battery, so new mail can arrive hours late while your phone is idle. Allowing unrestricted background use lets mail keep arriving about every 15 minutes.
contacts_empty_body: Contacts from your accounts' address books appear here once they have synced.
contacts_pick_card: Which account do you want to edit this contact in?
contacts_editor_invalid: Enter a name, an organisation or an email address.
contacts_editor_invalid_email: Check the email addresses you entered.
contacts_save_unconfirmed: Saved, but we couldn't confirm it
contacts_not_editable: This contact can't be edited here.
welcome_analytics_body: Optional. It tells us which features get used, whether mail syncs, and where setting up an account goes wrong. It never includes your messages, your calendar, your email addresses, or your contacts, and {app_name} works exactly the same whether you turn it on or not.
invitation_superseded_title: This invitation is out of date
invitation_superseded: The organiser has sent a newer version since this one. Open the newest invitation to answer.
invitation_description_shortened: Shortened: open the full invitation for the rest.
invitation_cannot_respond: This account can't send a response, so your answer would reach nobody.
invitation_conflicts_none: Nothing else in your calendar then
invitation_conflicts_one: 1 other thing in your calendar then
invitation_conflicts: {count} other things in your calendar then
invitation_conflicts_unknown: We haven't looked at your calendar yet
invitation_failed: Your answer wasn't sent. Try again.
invitation_reply_undelivered_body: Your answer to “{summary}” is saved, but your calendar server couldn't pass it on to {organizer}. We can email it from your account instead.
invitation_reply_undelivered_remember: Do this from now on for this account
